prompt: Yellow calls the big parade downtown
title: The Big Parade
irony: Yellow's loud fast calls to make the parade big only scatter it, and it turns big when she stops calling and marches slow inside it.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Yellow calls from her corner porch as paper lanterns light the empty night street.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green hugs his march-order facts and wants a big parade, but fears stepping off the curb.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black dares the line to race ahead, and the marchers scatter past the corner lamp.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The street joins the big-parade chant and lifts lanterns over the starting line.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Yellow calls faster from her porch, Green corrects each step, and the line tangles by the bench.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Navy hands round spare lanterns for Green's slow count, but Black races and lands in drums.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The street sings the big-parade chant again while the stalled line waves lanterns.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Yellow admits on her dark porch that her fast calls leave no room to march together.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Yellow steps off the porch with a soft drum and chooses to walk slow with them.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: The street sings the chant once more as Yellow walks slow and leads them home together.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The full street marches slow with lanterns while Yellow walks among the drums.
